construct_or_mutation: full 204 residues of wild type E. coli DmsD (UniProt P69853) plus 19-residue N-terminal His6 tag/thrombin extension
other_conditions: related structures: 3EFP, 3CW0; 15N-NOE read as sub-nanosecond timescale motions; loops between helices 5-6 and 7-8; no residue numbers listed
caveat_note: Temperature 25 °C is stated for the spectra recorded at 850 MHz and in the Fig. 1a legend; the paper gives no separate temperature for the 600 MHz NOE sample. Deposit lists 500 MHz relaxation field and 298.15 K; the paper reports 600 MHz NOE only. NOE values are not printed in the text.
experiment: Amide 15N heteronuclear NOE at 600 MHz (Varian Inova), non-deuterated 15N/13C-labeled DmsD
author_claim: Backbone of DmsD is well ordered; enhanced fast (sub-nanosecond) flexibility only in the loops between helices 5 and 6 and between helices 7 and 8; the 7-8 loop is the hinge between two subdomains.
anchor: In general, the backbone of the protein is well ordered, with enhanced fast timescale flexibility only observed in the loop regions between helices 5 and 6 and between helices 7 and 8.
locator: Results and discussion, Fig. 1b; conditions: Methods and experiments

construct_or_mutation: 2H/13C/15N-labeled DmsD, 204 residues plus 19-residue N-terminal His6 tag/thrombin extension
other_conditions: related structures: 3EFP; 63 residues with two signals, clustering near helix 5; no residue list in text; weaker peaks labeled B in Fig. 1a
caveat_note: Authors state the origin of the conformational heterogeneity is unclear (no prolines in the region; exposed cysteine, DTT had no effect). Exchange rate, populations and identity of the second state are not reported; no exchange regime is stated. Protein was unfolded in 8 M urea and refolded during purification.
experiment: 15N-HSQC TROSY at 850 MHz, second set of weaker 1HN-15N peaks
author_claim: A second set of weaker peaks for 63 residues near helix 5 indicates conformational heterogeneity of unclear origin; excess DTT did not change the spectra.
anchor: A second set of weaker 1HN-15N peaks was also identified for 63 residues broadly clustering near helix 5.
locator: Results and discussion, Fig. 1a; conditions: Methods and experiments
